# Agent Flight Recorder

Agent Flight Recorder is an open-source, local-first forensic replay console for AI coding agents. It records provider-emitted evidence and presents a read-only timeline; it never re-executes recorded tools, commands, or agent actions.

## Primary links

- Product tour: https://othmaneblial.github.io/Agent-Flight-Recorder/
- Field manual: https://othmaneblial.github.io/Agent-Flight-Recorder/docs.html
- Source repository: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Agent-Flight-Recorder
- Security model: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Agent-Flight-Recorder/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Validation evidence: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Agent-Flight-Recorder/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md

## Supported evidence surfaces

- Codex: 11 official lifecycle hooks plus version-tested transcript backfill.
- Claude Code: 33 documented command-hook events.
- Cursor: 21 documented local IDE/CLI hook events.
- OpenCode: CLI-discovered, version-tested SQLite/WAL backfill.
- Compatible agents: versioned `afr.event.v1` envelopes over stdin or loopback HTTP.

## Trust boundary

The recorder binds to loopback, emits no telemetry, masks common credentials by default, and encrypts evidence-bearing SQLite columns with AES-256-GCM. Indexed metadata remains plaintext. Provider-private or non-emitted data is not reconstructed; missing proof remains null, unknown, or an explicit capture gap.
